svg.title: WP-S-07 Figure 4-1: attack paths
svg.desc: Exposed interfaces: EX-01 Cellular links to remote operations and the fleet backend, network, into SZ-2: threats TS-01, TS-02, TS-04, TS-06, TS-13, TS-14; controls CSTR-01.01, CSTR-01.02, CSTR-03.01, CSTR-03.02, CSTR-05.03, CSTR-11.01, CSR-04, CSR-10; EX-02 GNSS antenna and receiver, adjacent, into SZ-2: threats TS-09; controls CSTR-08.01; EX-03 The physical scene as the sensors and microphones receive it (light, radio, sound, markings), adjacent, into SZ-2: threats TS-08, TS-10; controls CSTR-07.01, CSTR-07.02, CSTR-09.01; EX-04 Passenger interface (cabin screen, stop button) and the passenger app through the backend, local, into SZ-2: threats TS-14, TS-15; controls CSTR-11.01, CSTR-12.01, CSTR-12.02; EX-05 Service and debug ports (safety monitor, Autoware computer, vehicle diagnostic connector), physical, into SZ-3: threats TS-05, TS-11, TS-16; controls CR-03, CSTR-05.01, CSTR-05.02, CSTR-05.05, CSTR-03.03, CSTR-05.07; EX-06 Remote operations centre and fleet backend, off-board, network, into SZ-1: threats TS-03, TS-07, TS-12; controls CSR-02, CSR-06, CSR-10; EX-07 Short-range wireless on the vehicle (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth); none is fitted, adjacent, into SZ-2: no threat, decision DQ-037 A.
